limitations: Low bookings cannot identify unmet need or a reporting probability.
Reference mean is a need-covariate model benchmark; interval covers that mean only.
Peer matching excludes each target; Bayesian reference fits are in-sample unless held out.
Only officer field observations supply empirical labels; model flags are hypotheses.
Configured quantiles/priors are engineering choices; ties can exceed the nominal fraction.
Growth signals are context only; they never scale household exposure.
